svg.title: How a project keeps a team brief together
svg.desc: A project gives related chats a shared place for instructions and reference files. Save. Put the practice handbook in the project. Ask. Start a chat there and apply the handbook rule. Check. Open another project chat and see whether it uses the same rule.
svg.text: How a project keeps a team brief together
A project gives related chats a shared place for instructions and reference
Put the practice handbook in the project.
Start a chat there and apply the handbook rule.
Open another project chat and see whether it uses the same rule.
